designationHistory.indexText: Laguna Cartagena National Wildlife Refuge Established in 1989, Laguna Cartagena National Wildlife Refuge is one of the most important freshwater habitats for migrating and resident aquatic birds in Puerto Rico.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
